rationale: EdgeCore Digital Infrastructure is one US hyperscale data-center platform. Partners Group acquired the platform through EdgeCore Holdings, L.P. on November 10, 2022 and remains the majority owner; a 2024 syndication added undisclosed minority client co-investors without displacing Partners Group. Later disclosed transactions are debt or campus financing, not platform equity transfers.
recommendedChanges: Create one canonical EdgeCore Digital Infrastructure company.
Add Partners Group as the active majority owner from 2022-11-10 through EdgeCore Holdings, L.P.
Record GIC, OPTrust and Mount Elbert Capital Partners as former founding owners through the 2022 transfer, without inventing exit percentages or exact dates.
Represent the 2024 client syndication as minority co-investment context and do not create named owners that were not disclosed.
Exclude campuses, facilities, land and financing SPVs from separate PortCo counting.
unresolvedQuestions: Exact 2022 seller exit dates, percentages and management/sponsor rollover are not publicly disclosed.
Names and percentages of the 2024 client co-investors are not publicly disclosed.
Direct-source use of the proposed EdgeCore Digital Infrastructure Holdings LLC legal name was not found.
